quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Noor said, "I have finished my homework."
quests.reportedSpeech: Noor said that she had finished her homework.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Have finished' (present perfect) backshifts to 'had finished' (past perfect); 'I' and 'my' become 'she' and 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Present perfect 'have finished' moves two steps back — what tense is that?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Noor said, "I have finished my homework."" ➔ "Noor said that she had finished her homework."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Lucas said, "I have already eaten lunch."
quests.reportedSpeech: Lucas said that he had already eaten lunch.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Have eaten' becomes 'had eaten' — only the auxiliary shifts, not the participle; 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: The auxiliary 'have' changes, but the past participle 'eaten' stays the same.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Lucas said, "I have already eaten lunch."" ➔ "Lucas said that he had already eaten lunch."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Mei said, "My brother has never visited Japan."
quests.reportedSpeech: Mei said that her brother had never visited Japan.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'her', and 'has visited' backshifts to 'had visited'.
quests.nativeTip: Check the possessive first, then the present perfect auxiliary.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Mei said, "My brother has never visited Japan."" ➔ "Mei said that her brother had never visited Japan."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Ines said, "I finished the report already."
quests.reportedSpeech: Ines said that she had finished the report already.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Finished' (simple past) backshifts to 'had finished' (past perfect) because it happened before the moment of reporting; 'I' becomes 'she'.
quests.nativeTip: A completed past action reported later often shifts one more step back — into the past perfect.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Ines said, "I finished the report already."" ➔ "Ines said that she had finished the report already."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Chen said, "I locked the door."
quests.reportedSpeech: Chen said that he had locked the door.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Locked' shifts to 'had locked', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: Same pattern as before: a completed past action moves back one more step.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Chen said, "I locked the door."" ➔ "Chen said that he had locked the door."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Grace said, "The train left without me."
quests.reportedSpeech: Grace said that the train had left without her.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Left' backshifts to 'had left', and 'me' becomes 'her' since Grace is the one being reported.
quests.nativeTip: Notice two changes here — the verb tense and the object pronoun referring to Grace.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Grace said, "The train left without me."" ➔ "Grace said that the train had left without her."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Marcus said, "I will call you later."
quests.reportedSpeech: Marcus said that he would call me later.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' becomes 'would', and 'you' becomes 'me' because Marcus was speaking to the person now reporting it.
quests.nativeTip: 'Will' has a special past-time replacement — it isn't 'willed'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Marcus said, "I will call you later."" ➔ "Marcus said that he would call me later."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Priya said, "I will help you with the move."
quests.reportedSpeech: Priya said that she would help me with the move.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' shifts to 'would', 'I' becomes 'she', and 'you' becomes 'me'.
quests.nativeTip: Apply the same modal change again, and think about who 'you' refers to.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Priya said, "I will help you with the move."" ➔ "Priya said that she would help me with the move."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The airline said, "Flights will be delayed."
quests.reportedSpeech: The airline said that flights would be delayed.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will be' backshifts to 'would be'; no pronoun change is required.
quests.nativeTip: There is no pronoun to change here — focus only on the modal verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The airline said, "Flights will be delayed."" ➔ "The airline said that flights would be delayed."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Hassan said, "I can speak three languages."
quests.reportedSpeech: Hassan said that he could speak three languages.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Can' has its own past form — it isn't a regular verb ending.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Hassan said, "I can speak three languages."" ➔ "Hassan said that he could speak three languages."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Sofia said, "My father can fix anything."
quests.reportedSpeech: Sofia said that her father could fix anything.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'her', and 'can' becomes 'could'.
quests.nativeTip: Two changes: the possessive pronoun and the modal verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Sofia said, "My father can fix anything."" ➔ "Sofia said that her father could fix anything."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The technician said, "We can fix it quickly."
quests.reportedSpeech: The technician said that they could fix it quickly.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'can' becomes 'could'.
quests.nativeTip: Recall the 'we' → 'they' rule together with the modal change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The technician said, "We can fix it quickly."" ➔ "The technician said that they could fix it quickly."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Ravi said, "I may be late."
quests.reportedSpeech: Ravi said that he might be late.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'May' becomes 'might', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: 'May' shifts to a specific past-time modal — not 'must'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Ravi said, "I may be late."" ➔ "Ravi said that he might be late."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Elena said, "I must leave early."
quests.reportedSpeech: Elena said that she had to leave early.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Must' (necessity for this occasion) shifts to 'had to'; 'I' becomes 'she'.
quests.nativeTip: Obligation 'must' about a specific occasion usually becomes a phrase with 'had to'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Elena said, "I must leave early."" ➔ "Elena said that she had to leave early."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Kwame said, "I may need help with the box."
quests.reportedSpeech: Kwame said that he might need help with the box.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'May' becomes 'might', 'I' becomes 'he', and the verb stays as 'need', not 'needed'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep the base form of the verb after the modal — don't add '-ed'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Kwame said, "I may need help with the box."" ➔ "Kwame said that he might need help with the box."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Layla said, "My colleagues are working on the update."
quests.reportedSpeech: Layla said that her colleagues were working on the update.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'her', and 'are working' backshifts to 'were working'.
quests.nativeTip: Check the possessive pronoun and the continuous tense together.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Layla said, "My colleagues are working on the update."" ➔ "Layla said that her colleagues were working on the update."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Theo said, "I am still waiting for my results."
quests.reportedSpeech: Theo said that he was still waiting for his results.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'I' becomes 'he', 'my' becomes 'his', and 'am waiting' becomes 'was waiting'.
quests.nativeTip: Three items need attention: the pronoun, the possessive, and the continuous tense.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Theo said, "I am still waiting for my results."" ➔ "Theo said that he was still waiting for his results."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The nurses said, "We are taking care of our patients."
quests.reportedSpeech: The nurses said that they were taking care of their patients.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' and 'our' both become 'they'/'their', and 'are taking' backshifts to 'were taking'.
quests.nativeTip: Both 'we' and 'our' change the same way — to which pronoun?
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The nurses said, "We are taking care of our patients."" ➔ "The nurses said that they were taking care of their patients."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Nadia said, "I have lost my passport."
quests.reportedSpeech: Nadia said that she had lost her passport.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Have lost' becomes 'had lost'; 'I' becomes 'she' and 'my' becomes 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the present perfect and update both the pronoun and the possessive.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Nadia said, "I have lost my passport."" ➔ "Nadia said that she had lost her passport."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The mechanics said, "We have already checked the engine."
quests.reportedSpeech: The mechanics said that they had already checked the engine.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'have checked' becomes 'had checked'.
quests.nativeTip: Recall the 'we' → 'they' rule and combine it with present perfect backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The mechanics said, "We have already checked the engine."" ➔ "The mechanics said that they had already checked the engine."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Victor said, "My team has won the tournament."
quests.reportedSpeech: Victor said that his team had won the tournament.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'his', and 'has won' becomes 'had won'.
quests.nativeTip: Check the possessive pronoun, and then look at how far back the present perfect needs to move.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Victor said, "My team has won the tournament."" ➔ "Victor said that his team had won the tournament."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Isabella said, "I will bring my laptop to the meeting."
quests.reportedSpeech: Isabella said that she would bring her laptop to the meeting.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' becomes 'would', 'I' becomes 'she', and 'my' becomes 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Three items change together: the modal, the pronoun, and the possessive.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Isabella said, "I will bring my laptop to the meeting."" ➔ "Isabella said that she would bring her laptop to the meeting."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The committee said, "We will announce our decision soon."
quests.reportedSpeech: The committee said that they would announce their decision soon.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' and 'our' become 'they'/'their', and 'will announce' becomes 'would announce'.
quests.nativeTip: Both 'we' and 'our' shift the same way, alongside the modal.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The committee said, "We will announce our decision soon."" ➔ "The committee said that they would announce their decision soon."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Omar said, "My brother will drive us to the airport."
quests.reportedSpeech: Omar said that his brother would drive them to the airport.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'My' becomes 'his', 'will' becomes 'would', and 'us' becomes 'them' since the reporter is not part of that group.
quests.nativeTip: Notice three changes: the possessive, the modal, and the object pronoun 'us'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Omar said, "My brother will drive us to the airport."" ➔ "Omar said that his brother would drive them to the airport."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Fatima said, "I can finish my thesis by June."
quests.reportedSpeech: Fatima said that she could finish her thesis by June.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', 'I' becomes 'she', and 'my' becomes 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the modal change with the pronoun and possessive changes.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima said, "I can finish my thesis by June."" ➔ "Fatima said that she could finish her thesis by June."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The doctor said, "You must rest for a few days."
quests.reportedSpeech: The doctor said that I had to rest for a few days.
quests.ruleExplanation: Because the patient is now reporting it, 'you' becomes 'I', and 'must' becomes 'had to'.
quests.nativeTip: Think about who 'you' refers to if the patient is the one reporting this later.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The doctor said, "You must rest for a few days."" ➔ "The doctor said that I had to rest for a few days."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The players said, "We must train harder."
quests.reportedSpeech: The players said that they had to train harder.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' becomes 'they', and 'must' becomes 'had to'.
quests.nativeTip: Apply the 'we' → 'they' rule together with the modal change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The players said, "We must train harder."" ➔ "The players said that they had to train harder."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Chen said, "I have already sent the email."
quests.reportedSpeech: Chen said that he had already sent the email.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Have sent' becomes 'had sent', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: This is present perfect — it moves two steps back, into the past perfect.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Chen said, "I have already sent the email."" ➔ "Chen said that he had already sent the email."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The organizers said, "We will provide our own equipment."
quests.reportedSpeech: The organizers said that they would provide their own equipment.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'We' and 'our' become 'they'/'their', and 'will provide' becomes 'would provide'.
quests.nativeTip: This combines three earlier rules — the pronoun, the possessive, and the future modal.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The organizers said, "We will provide our own equipment."" ➔ "The organizers said that they would provide their own equipment."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Priya said, "I can't find my notes."
quests.reportedSpeech: Priya said that she couldn't find her notes.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can't' becomes 'couldn't', 'I' becomes 'she', and 'my' becomes 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Negative modals shift too — 'can't' has its own past form.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Priya said, "I can't find my notes."" ➔ "Priya said that she couldn't find her notes."
